reviewed_installed_license.rationale: Owner decision 2026-10-30: accept. SciPy's own code is BSD-3-Clause. Its binary wheel metadata 'License' field also reproduces the licenses of bundled third-party libraries: OpenBLAS (BSD-3-Clause), LAPACK (BSD-3-Clause-Open-MPI), libgfortran (GPL-3.0-or-later WITH GCC-exception-3.1, GCC Runtime Library Exception) and libquadmath (LGPL-2.1-or-later, which is not covered by the GCC exception). They are dynamically linked inside the third-party scipy wheel; scipy is an optional extra that ANYgeometry neither bundles nor redistributes (bundled=false). Any other text, version or component requires re-review. Applies to the Linux (manylinux x86_64) wheel; other platforms have their own records.
